text:
Omar V (Partnerships): Quick heads-up: OrchX (orchestration tool) wants a joint demo showing LangChain runner + our gateway routing and marketplace listing. They want a short integration checklist and a joint announcement window in June.

Nadia P (Eng): From eng: clarify scope - LangChain runner + orchestration hooks (scale up/down, canary)? Also need supported model variants list.

Omar V (Partnerships): They want scale policies (canary, blue/green), a sample LangChain pipeline, and docs for marketplace. Target demo week June 7.

Diego R (DevEx): I'll create a sample repo with a GitHub Actions workflow that deploys the gateway + OrchX controller and a LangChain task. Will include quickstart and README. ETA: PR by Friday.

Hannah S (Product): Marketplace deliverables: SKU mapping, supported topologies, security notes for Private, and graceful fallback text. I'll draft SKU options by next Tue.

Jules M (Marketing): Need perf numbers and a short 60s demo script. Also want co-branding guidance for the announcement. LegalBot, any constraints?

LegalBot: Provide dataflow diagram and partner coop language for review. Recommend "Validated with OrchX" until formal cert completes.

Nadia P (Eng): Perf matrix: redwood-7b, redwood-13b-q4, seq 512/1024, batch 1/4. I'll queue runs once Diego uploads prompts. Note: OrchX controller requires a kube feature gate for iptables mode. Will document.

Diego R (DevEx): Uploading prompts to gs://redwood-partners/orchx-lc-1769 and opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-repo/orchx-langchain-demo/pull/3

Omar V (Partnerships): Action items recap: Nadia - perf + compat doc (due TOM). Diego - demo repo + prompts (due TOM AM). Hannah - SKU copy (due Tue). LegalBot - review after dataflow posted (due in 3 days). Jules - draft announcement outline after perf numbers.

Jules M (Marketing): Will prepare announcement outline and 60s demo script draft.

Omar V (Partnerships): Ok team, reconvene next Wed 9am PT to review perf and content. Thanks!
